mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_definition ( plugin_id, version, display_name, main_class, artifact_path, artifact_sha256, capabilities_json, config_schema_json, account_schema_json, dependency_jars_json, uploaded_by, runtime_engine, entry_point, execution_mode ) VALUES ( #{pluginId}, #{version}, #{displayName}, #{mainClass}, #{artifactPath}, #{artifactSha256}, CAST(#{capabilitiesJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{configSchemaJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{accountSchemaJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{dependencyJarsJson} AS JSON), #{uploadedBy}, #{runtimeEngine}, #{entryPoint}, #{executionMode} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE execution_mode = VALUES(execution_mode), runtime_engine = VALUES(runtime_engine), entry_point = VALUES(entry_point), version = VALUES(version), display_name = VALUES(display_name), main_class = VALUES(main_class), artifact_path = VALUES(artifact_path), artifact_sha256 = VALUES(artifact_sha256), capabilities_json = VALUES(capabilities_json), config_schema_json = VALUES(config_schema_json), account_schema_json = VALUES(account_schema_json), dependency_jars_json = CASE WHEN #{overwriteDependencies} THEN VALUES(dependency_jars_json) ELSE dependency_jars_json END, uploaded_by = VALUES(uploaded_by), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_definition WHERE plugin_id LIKE #{keywordLike} OR display_name LIKE #{keywordLike}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_installation WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} AND deleted = FALSE
